# sealing-wall.txt — sealed room with its sealing wall flagged func_detail (hammer-optimisation-func-detail)
#
# Same format as decorated-room.txt (see its header). The wall-x-pos brush is
# one of the six shell brushes: without it the room leaks, so flagging it
# func_detail must produce exactly one SealingBrushFuncDetail validation
# warning (brush #3), and the built tree must report unsealed.
brush floor
plane -1 0 0 144
plane 1 0 0 144
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 16
plane 0 0 1 0
brush ceiling
plane -1 0 0 144
plane 1 0 0 144
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 -128
plane 0 0 1 144
brush wall-x-neg
plane -1 0 0 144
plane 1 0 0 -128
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 128
brush wall-x-pos detail
plane -1 0 0 -128
plane 1 0 0 144
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 128
brush wall-y-neg
plane -1 0 0 128
plane 1 0 0 128
plane 0 -1 0 144
plane 0 1 0 -128
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 128
brush wall-y-pos
plane -1 0 0 128
plane 1 0 0 128
plane 0 -1 0 -128
plane 0 1 0 144
plane 0 0 -1 0
plane 0 0 1 128
